automated_gates.scope_note: The real-reference V coverage, the requested 9--10 of 19 rendered liquids at S 0.30--0.85, the requested 10-percent V 0.05--0.09 tail, the corrected full glass-material contract, and the explicit dark-liquid-versus-holder relation are automated. The prior 6--8 of 19 at V<=0.2 is retained only as waived historical evidence. Hue, absolute holder V, backdrop transmission through empty glass, the visible liquid boundary, labels and overall-look resemblance remain side-by-side review decisions; proxy intervals are evidence, not physical-accuracy claims.

foam_appearance.evidence_label: measured synthetic foam-mask pixels and manifested authored spheres
foam_appearance.method: Foam HSV is measured only where decoded class mask equals foam=2; hue distance is circular and becomes weak evidence for nearly grey pixels. Authored sphere count and camera-visible mask components are reported separately; neither is relabeled as the other.

glass_edge_highlight_proxies.method: A one-pixel morphological boundary is taken from all non-ignore semantic pixels inside the manifested vial bbox. HSV V percentiles, V>=0.80 fraction, and Sobel gradient magnitude are reported there. These are reproducible edge/highlight proxies, not a claim that the boundary pixels exclusively segment physical glass.

holder_appearance.extreme_or_very_dark_definition: manifested material V <= 0.12 or rendered liquid mean V <= 0.12
holder_appearance.proxy_method: HSV V over decoded blocked=3 pixels after removing every pixel inside the manifested synthetic sticker bbox. The remaining class can include probe or other blocker geometry, so it is explicitly a blocked-non-sticker holder proxy rather than holder segmentation.

rendered_liquid_hsv.method: Rendered H is the saturation-weighted circular mean over RGB pixels whose decoded class mask is liquid=1; S and V are arithmetic means over those same pixels. Hue is null when all selected pixels are achromatic. Circular hue error and saturation retention compare rendered pixels with the manifested material HSV.

rendered_liquid_v.method: mean HSV V over RGB pixels whose decoded class mask equals liquid=1

metric_formulas.backdrop_color: median HSV saturation and median normalized RGB/tint deltas
metric_formulas.backdrop_luma: Rec.709 luma median/p05/p95 in declared backdrop ROI
metric_formulas.blur_laplacian_variance_8bit: variance of OpenCV Laplacian on 8-bit scene grayscale
metric_formulas.blur_tenengrad_normalized: mean squared 3x3 Sobel gradients on normalized scene grayscale
metric_formulas.haze_proxies: backdrop luma p05 floor and backdrop p95-minus-p05 contrast
metric_formulas.noise_normalized_sigma: 1.4826 times MAD after Gaussian sigma=1.5 backdrop residual
metric_formulas.scene_grayscale_percentiles: OpenCV RGB-to-grayscale p05, median, and p95 in declared rows
